findings.source_quote: ἀποδεδομένης τῆς κατὰ τὴν βασίλειον τραπέζης τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἰσραήλ.
findings.english_quote: since what belongs at the royal table has been allotted to the sons of Israel
findings.issue: The supplied genitive τραπέζης makes the table itself the head of the absolute construction. The draft instead makes unspecified things belonging at the table the allotted item. A table-provisions metonymy is contextually possible, but this wording conceals the source's table-as-subject construction and resembles the note's proposed accusative reconstruction. The case diagnosis also needs qualification: κατά need not govern τραπέζης if τὴν βασίλειον is substantival or elliptical. The printed reading is verified; this is not an OCR or print-verification block.
findings.suggested_revision: Keep 'the table ... has been allotted to the sons of Israel' visible in the main text. A provisional unaltered-text candidate is 'since the table corresponding to the royal one has been allotted to the sons of Israel,' taking τὴν βασίλειον substantivally, with an understood table. Explain that analysis and preserve the uncertainty in the note. Distinguish it from the proposed change τραπέζης → τράπεζαν. Any replacement requires fresh review.

findings.source_quote: τοσαύτη γὰρ αὐτῶν ἦν ἡ φιλία, ὡς καὶ συνοστεῦσαι αὐτῷ ἐν πᾶσιν οἷς βούλοιτο αὐτοῖς ἐνοῦν.
findings.english_quote: for their friendship with him was so close that they even kept company with him in everything he wished to share with them.
findings.issue: συνοστεῦσαι expresses close joining or intimate attachment, stronger than merely keeping company. Reading the printed ἐνοῦν as corresponding to ἑνοῦν is defensible here, but on that reading αὐτοῖς identifies the people with whom Simon wished to unite. 'Everything he wished to share with them' shifts the expression toward sharing things rather than joining with people in those matters. The notes disclose the uncertainty adequately; the requested change concerns the main text's representation of the chosen reading, not the existence of alternatives.
findings.suggested_revision: A more source-transparent provisional rendering is: 'for their friendship was so close that they were even closely united with him in every matter in which he wished to join with them.' Retain and explain the supplied ἐνοῦν; continue to label αὐτοὺς ἐνεῖναι as a conjectural alteration, not another reading of the unchanged words. Submit the revised English to fresh review.
